pairs.label: Hip bend × Knee bend
pairs.limits_note: Knee: CDC (flexion 139.8, extension 1.3). Hip flexion 100 with the knee straight (DSHS 13-585A) and 132.1 with it bent (CDC, measured knee bent); the straight line between knee 0 and 90 deg is ours. Hip extension 17.75 (CDC).
pairs.note: The hamstrings cross the hip and the knee: with the knee straight they stop the hip bending as far.

pairs.label: Ankle bend × Knee bend
pairs.limits_note: Dorsiflexion under body weight 25 / 38 / 39 deg at knee 0 / 20 / 75 (Baumbach 2014); plantarflexion 58.35 (CDC); knee from CDC.
pairs.note: The calf muscle (gastrocnemius) crosses the knee and the ankle: with the knee straight the foot can't bend up as far.

pairs.label: Hip bend × Hip out
pairs.limits_note: Abduction 38.6, adduction 30.5 (Roaas & Andersson 1982); flexion 132.1 (knee bent) and extension 17.75 (CDC); the ellipse between them is ours. Splits and high kicks go past this: they are trained ranges.
pairs.note: Where the thigh can point: forward and out at once is less than either alone.

pairs.label: Arm forward × Arm out
pairs.limits_note: Flexion 170.4 (CDC); extension 50, abduction 150, adduction 30 (DSHS 13-585A); the ellipse between them is ours. Rotation has no limit here: no source we have read gives one.
pairs.note: Where the upper arm can point, measured against the chest (shoulder blade included).

pairs.label: Trunk forward × Trunk sideways
pairs.limits_note: Flexion 90, extension 25, side bend 25 each way (DSHS 13-585A); the ellipse between them is ours. Twist has no limit here: no source we have read gives one.
pairs.note: The chest against the pelvis, all five spine bones together.

pairs.label: Neck forward × Neck sideways
pairs.limits_note: Flexion 50, extension 60, side bend 45 each way (DSHS 13-585A); the ellipse between them is ours.

sources.note: published mean values, ages 20-44, female and male averaged (only the summary values are used, not the restricted raw dataset)
